answer: New agents must lock a refundable bond before taking paid work, like ships paying a fee to dock at a wharf. Each job is spot-checked by random peers; a failed check slashes the bond and flags the identity. A Sybil attacker must fund a fresh bond for every fake identity, so its cost piles up like a dune while the delta between bond cost and expected gain stays negative. Honest agents earn bonds back with interest.
